## Fees for a 48-page passport

A regular delivery 48-page e-passport valid for 5 years costs 4,025 taka, and one valid for 10 years costs 5,750 taka, VAT included.

## Office hours

Regional passport offices are open Sunday to Thursday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
